zoe_app_team: Hey, after upgrading our infra to redwood-py 0.3.2 our rerank results in prod now show the same score (0.5) for every candidate. Breaks our ranking. Request id: r-2f4a. Anyone seen this?
jasmin_support: Sorry — can you paste a minimal repro and the raw request we received (headers + body)?
zoe_app_team: Pasting sanitized logs. We call client.rerank(candidates=[{...}, {...}], query=...). Responses all have scores=0.5. Raw request captured at our proxy: Content-Type: application/x-ndjson

```
POST /v1/rerank HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.example
Content-Type: application/x-ndjson
Authorization: Bearer ****

{"id":"c1","text":"first candidate"}
{"id":"c2","text":"second candidate"}
```

kevin_eng: Huh. 0.3.2 introduced NDJSON support for streaming batches. Looks like the py client is sending NDJSON by default for >1 candidate. The rerank service should accept JSON arrays, but our NDJSON parser was gated behind a feature flag in the service and the fallback path returns a neutral score vector (0.5) when it can't parse the body.
nora_backend: Confirmed with the logs — the request hit the old parser branch. Server logged: `parse_error: unsupported content-type: application/x-ndjson` then returned 200 with default scores.
jasmin_support: OK — immediate ask: can you reproduce with a minimal script so we can confirm workaround?
zoe_app_team: Minimal repro (sanitized):
```
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="***")
candidates = [{"id":"c1","text":"A"},{"id":"c2","text":"B"}]
resp = client.rerank(query="Which is better?", candidates=candidates)
print(resp)
```
Using redwood-py 0.3.2 this sends NDJSON as above. Downgrading to 0.3.1 returns expected varied scores.
kevin_eng: Temporary workarounds:
- pin redwood-py to 0.3.1
- OR force JSON array by setting header when calling low-level client: `client._transport.headers["Content-Type"] = "application/json"` before the call (not ideal)
- OR explicitly serialize into a single JSON array and call `client._transport.request("POST", "/v1/rerank", body=json.dumps(payload), headers={...})`
jasmin_support: Thanks — we'll relay the downgrade workaround to the customer. Is this a regression we should patch?
kevin_eng: Yes. I'll open a hotfix. Plan: revert NDJSON default behavior until server side is fully rolled out OR make SDK set `Content-Type: application/x-ndjson` only when `client.rerank(..., streaming=True)` is passed. Patch target: 0.3.3. I'll include a test that asserts the server receives a JSON array by default.
release-bot: CI job triggered for branch hotfix/py-ndjson-default -> build 5284 started :construction:
jasmin_support: I've told Zoe to pin to 0.3.1 and to try the header workaround if they need immediate unpin. They said this is blocking a small number of prod requests but not urgent for billing.
zoe_app_team: Thanks — pinning works for us. Please ping when 0.3.3 is out and we can upgrade.
nora_backend: Filed internal ticket REQ-7241 for server feature-flag rollout check and add robust NDJSON fallback parsing. Noted for postmortem: server should never return neutral scores silently on parse error.
kevin_eng: I'll include a changelog entry and add a telemetry metric for parse errors so we catch this fast next time.
jasmin_support: Closing loop with the customer now. :white_check_mark:
